title: Virtual coordinate embedding
statement: For natural numbers $K,m$, define an injection from the $m+1$ coordinates indexed by $0,1,\ldots,m$ into the $K+m+1$ coordinates indexed by $0,1,\ldots,K+m$: it sends $0$ to $0$ and each $i\ge1$ to $K+i$.
